title: Instagram’s Effect Builder makes new filters from AI prompts
summary: After expanding its Edits app to macOS last week, Instagram's next move is launching this Effect Builder that generates custom filters for your Stories posts with AI. Available now for US residents who are over 18, it has a prompt box for describing your filter idea to the chatbo
reason: Instagram launched a non-model consumer product feature (AI Effect Builder for generating Story filters), reported by The Verge, a reputable media outlet; this is a product launch rather than a model/capability release, so it falls under the industry rule.
